text: Revenue went up by 1000 BRL between 2016-12 and 2017-01. The largest contribution came from SP (600 BRL). The second largest contribution came from RJ (400 BRL). Revenue is defined as: Total payments received for delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
